$comment: Project A (AI Cost Governor design note, docs/audits/ARGUS_PROJECT_A_AI_COST_GOVERNOR_DESIGN_NOTE.md). Phase A4 governor logic exists as real code but is OFF by default (aiCostGovernorEnabledEnvVar unset -> isRuntimeFlagEnabled() returns false) and, even when enabled, defaults to SHADOW-ONLY - real routing only changes once an operator ALSO explicitly sets aiCostGovernorLiveEnabledEnvVar to 'true' (default false, same off-unless-explicit convention as every other flag here). Until then it only computes and logs what it WOULD have chosen without changing real AIRouter.routeTask() behavior. It never touches ChiefTrader/RiskEngine/OMS/consensus/routeConsensus - see the design note's safety-boundary list.
